title: Cline Cli with openai-compatible provider don't recognize OPENAI_API_KEY variable

labels.name: CLI
labels.description: Issues related to the Cline CLI

body: ### Cline Surface CLI ### Cline Version 3.0.73 ### Beta version - [ ] I am using a beta version of Cline ### What happened? When cline cli is set with an openai-compatible provider, the providers.json is like this 👍🏽 ``` { "version": 1, "lastUsedProvider": "openai-compatible", "modes": {}, "providers": { "openai-compatible": { "settings": { "provider": "openai-compatible", "model": "claude-....", "baseUrl": "https://api.openai-provider.com/v1", "reasoning": { "enabled": false } }, "updatedAt": "2026-10-22T04:49:16.393Z", "tokenSource": "manual" } } } ``` and the env variable **OPENAI_API_KEY** is set with the api value, cline works, it recognizes the model indicated in the providers.json. However, when trying to change to another model form the provider with `/model` command, it is not listing them. But, if i unset the OPENAI_API_KEY variable, and add the apikey in the providers.json file : `"apikey" : "sk-......."` then when i try to switch models with `/model` command, it lists all the available models from provider i asked cline about this, and this is what cline answered ### Steps to reproduce 1. Install cline cli 2. Configure an openai-compatible provider 3. Set the apiKey in the providers.json file 4. Open Cline cli 5. Try switching models with `/model` command (it should work) 6. remove the "apikey" entry from providers.json file 7. set the api key in OPENAI_API_KEY env variable 8. Open cline cli 9. Try switching models with `/model` command (it won't show the models) ### Provider/Model openai-compatible/claude-sonnet-5-5 ### Diagnostics line --version 3.0.73 ### System Information Ubuntu 26.04.1 LTS in WSL2 (Windows 11)
